use_cases: Acoustic infill batts in wall stud cavities
retrieval.rag_summary:
Hushtec Batt is an unverified catalog placeholder within the Hushtec brand
family. Hushtec specializes strictly in exterior and industrial noise control
systems—including portable acoustic curtains, temporary fence barriers, and
acoustic enclosures—and does not manufacture residential or commercial internal
cavity insulation batts. For cavity acoustic batts in Australian construction,
products such as Bradford Soundscreen, Fletcher Soundbreak, or Ecowool
NoiseBreak are specified.
